attempts.text:
**The window starts in a five-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 4, `mraZ`, `cra`, `fruR`, `ilvN` and `ilvI`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99 to 99.6% of them, hesitating most at `fruR`, 0.23 bits.

**A fork follows at column 5**, where the model names 74% of calls and hesitates 0.36 bits; the branch carries protein YabR in 64% of chromosomes. Then columns 6 to 11, `leuO` to `leuD`, [[leucine biosynthesis]], a spine carried by 92 to 96% of chromosomes, named in 95 to 99.8% of calls. Column 12 is variable, `setA` in 61%.

**A long spine runs from `sgrT` to `caiA`**, columns 13 to 42, [[sugar and thiamine transport]] among its genes, carried by 92 to 96% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 2% of calls. The model names 77 to 100% there, but hesitates most at `djlA`, column 26, 0.79 bits, naming it in 77%. Column 43 is variable, `caiB` persistent in 90%.

**Then `caiC` to `rpsT`**, columns 44 to 58, [[carnitine and carbamoyl phosphate metabolism]], a spine in 90 to 96% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 4% of calls, named in 93 to 98%. Column 59 is variable, an IS1-like element transposase in 26%, the most hesitant column at 0.81 bits, in a region of plasticity in 8% of calls.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 60 to 62, `nhaR` to `mokC`, are a spine in 95 to 96% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 11 to 23% of calls, named in 82 to 89%. Column 63 is a fork, in a region of plasticity in 25% of calls, carrying a transposase in 44% and a fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone in 23%. Columns 64 to 72, `dnaJ` to `yaaA`, [[chaperone and stress response]], are a spine in 90 to 95%, named in 83 to 99%. Columns 73 to 79 are fork and variable columns, named in 98 to 99%, ending at `yjjY`, in 37% of chromosomes.

label: mraZ
facts:
WINDOW: the mraZ window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mraZ, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,632 to 3,711 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mraZ once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 96% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,597 calls, named 99%, 0.15 bits; shell 3,487 calls, named 60%, 0.99 bits; cloud 116 calls, named 1%, 2.06 bits. Outside an RGP 41,924 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 1,276 calls, named 74%, 0.81 bits. Columns: 68 spine, 3 fork, 9 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.81 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 96%); 1,276 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 59 ("IS1-like element transposase") 0.81 bits, RGP 8%; column 26 (djlA) 0.79 bits, RGP 0%; column 60 (nhaR) 0.68 bits, RGP 11%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 63 (fork), RGP 25%; the least: columns 0-4 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-4 (5 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: mraZ, cra, fruR, ilvN "acetolactate synthase small subunit", ilvI. named 99-99.6% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 4 (ilvI), named 99%; most hesitant at column 2 (fruR), 0.23 bits.
2. column 5 fork: RGP 0%. named 74%; 0.36 bits.
   5: "protein YabR" S 64%; also "hypothetical protein" S 14%
3. columns 6-11 (6 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: leuO, leuL, leuA, leuB, leuC "3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large…", leuD. named 95-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 7 (leuL), named 95%; most hesitant at column 6 (leuO), 0.66 bits.
4. column 12 variable: RGP 0%. named 96%; 0.41 bits.
   12: setA S 61%
5. columns 13-42 (30 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0-2%. Genes: sgrT "glucose uptake inhibitor SgrT", sgrR, thiB, thiP, thiQ "thiamine ABC transporter ATP-bindin…", yabI "DedA family protein", araC, araB, araA, araD "class II aldolase/adducin family pr…", polB, rapA, rluA, djlA, lptD, surA, pdxA, rsmA, apaG, apaH "bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase…", folA, kefC, kefF "NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductase", yaaU "MFS transporter", fixX, fixC, fixB, fixA "putative electron transfer flavopro…", caiT "L-carnitine/gamma-butyrobetaine ant…", caiA. named 77-100% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 26 (djlA), named 77%, 0.79 bits.
6. column 43 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 97%; 0.29 bits.
   43: caiB P 90%
7. columns 44-58 (15 columns) spine: share 90-96%, all P, RGP 0.4-4%. Genes: caiC, caiD, caiE, caiF, carB, carA "carbamoyl phosphate synthase small…", dapB, rihC, ispH, fkpB, lspA, ileS, ribF, yaaY "DUF2575 family protein", rpsT. named 93-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 53 (fkpB), named 93%; most hesitant at column 58 (rpsT), 0.28 bits.
8. column 59 variable: RGP 8%. named 79%; 0.81 bits.
   59: "IS1-like element transposase" S 26%
9. columns 60-62 (3 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 11-23%. Genes: nhaR, nhaA "Na+/H+ antiporter NhaA", mokC. named 82-89% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 62 (mokC), named 82%; most hesitant at column 60 (nhaR), 0.68 bits.
10. column 63 fork: RGP 25%. named 81%; 0.50 bits.
   63: "transposase" S 44%; also "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone" S 23%
11. columns 64-72 (9 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 4-24%. Genes: dnaJ, dnaK "molecular chaperone DnaK", yaaI "DUF2541 family protein", msyB, satP, mog, tal, yaaJ "alanine:cation symporter family pro…", yaaA "peroxide stress protein YaaA". named 83-99% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 64 (dnaJ), named 83%, 0.47 bits.
12. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-2%. named 98-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 78, named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.18 bits (column 73).
   columns 73-78 variable, share 49-86%, all P: yaaX "DUF2502 domain-containing protein" 86%, thrC 83%, thrB 76%, thrA 67%, thrL "thr operon leader peptide" 58%, yjtD "TrmH family RNA methyltransferase" 49%
   79 fork: yjjY P 37% "protein YjjY"; also arcA P 22%

END: the window ends at column 79, yjjY, in 37% of chromosomes.
